name: What is the difference between fence-post repair and replacement?
description: Repair fixes minor post damage, while replacement is for posts that are extensively damaged, rotted, or broken beyond repair.

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between fence-post repair and replacement?

acceptedAnswer.text: Fence-post repair involves fixing an existing post that has minor damage, such as reinforcing a slightly wobbly post or addressing early signs of rot at the base. This often means adding support or treating a localized issue to extend the post's life. Fence-post replacement, on the other hand, is necessary when a post is extensively damaged, severely rotted, or broken beyond repair, requiring the removal of the old post and installation of a new one. Replacement is a more involved process but ensures the fence's long-term stability.
acceptedAnswer.description: Repair fixes minor post damage, while replacement is for posts that are extensively damaged, rotted, or broken beyond repair.
